implementation: Separately labeled updated/ Linux headless maintenance port; CPU Eigen ICP solve and CUDA geometry operators

environment.cuda_target: 86 (embedded sm_86 SASS and compute_86 PTX; driver selection not measured)

ctest.meaning: Three integration entries: component regressions, moving synthetic demo, replay of that generated recording

sanitizers.scope: --self-test --demo, all production operators; no real sensor data
sanitizers.qualification: This sanitizer version checks global initialization. CPU reference checks and instrumented scratch experiment cover the reduction defect.
sanitizers.command_template: compute-sanitizer --tool TOOL --error-exitcode 99 [--leak-check full for memcheck] build/openfusion_headless --self-test --demo --output sanitizer-TOOL

defect_experiments.integration: Unmodified original volume kernel must fail the guard-slab check
defect_experiments.icp: Original 512-entry reduction with finite shared-scratch initialization failed the upper-triangle AtA CPU-reference comparison; the equivalently initialized fixed reduction passed all self-tests
defect_experiments.qualification: The ICP experiment is deliberately instrumented, not a claim that arbitrary original shared-memory contents produce a deterministic failure.

isolated_build.configuration: Release, default512^3, source manifest verified before build, fresh upstream submodule checkout

demo.input: Deterministic analytically generated three spheres and back plane, quantized uint16 axial depth in millimeters

reference_thresholds.scope: Only the hard negative truncation classification permits either unchanged or boundary-updated state inside this separately counted band.

limitations: Synthetic small-motion evidence; no real camera recording or benchmark quality/throughput claim.
Original OpenGL GUI, live camera SDKs and optional image filters are outside the updated build.
Nearest-voxel raycasting, fixed 1.5 mm step and radial nearest-pixel TSDF retain silhouette and normal errors.
Mean analytic plane normal angular error was about 25.09 degrees at 512^3 despite matching the implemented finite-difference operator.
Generic replay uses a fixed 1024 mm cube, initial camera at world z=768 mm, original negative-camera-z convention and zero depth offset.
No relocalization or loop closure; rejected ICP stops generic replay before integration.
No overall upstream license file was found; original and third-party terms are preserved.

artifacts.viewer_input: Linux run-512/demo: actual saved CUDA raycasts, PLY points, JSON and generated synthetic inputs
artifacts.screenshot_origin: Three image panels from the generated standalone viewer, inspected in Chrome
browser_checks: no JavaScript errors or external requests
